intersection.headline: Calvin Klein taps Jude Bellingham for Icon Cotton Stretch campaign
intersection.summary: Calvin Klein, part of PVH Corp., has launched an Icon Cotton Stretch underwear campaign with Real Madrid and England midfielder Jude Bellingham. It is his debut campaign for the brand.

intersection.headline: CeeDee Lamb designs 19-piece holiday capsule with Abercrombie & Fitch
intersection.summary: The Dallas Cowboys receiver worked with Abercrombie's design team on a 19-piece collection of outerwear, knitwear, shirts, trousers and neckties. Abercrombie is the official fashion partner of the NFL. The collection launched online Tuesday and is also in select stores.

sports.headline: WNBA Finals Game 7 draws record 3.3m viewers as Golden State Valkyries win title in second season
sports.summary: Game 7 was the first in WNBA history and the most-watched WNBA playoff game ever. It was the second-most-watched WNBA game since 1997. The seven-game series averaged about 1.89m viewers, a Finals record. Golden State became champions in just their second season, which is unprecedented for an expansion team in a major US sport.

sports.headline: Mark Walter explores Cadillac F1 team stake sale at $3bn valuation
sports.summary: Sportico reports that the TWG Global owner is seeking at least $3bn for the Cadillac F1 team, with at least seven interested parties. TWG had denied any sale plans in August. The report follows Walter's sales of the Lakers and a Chelsea stake amid federal investigations. The team reportedly expects to lose about $400m this season.

fashion.headline: Yeezy returns to the runway in Los Angeles for its first major show in over four years
fashion.summary: Ye's Yeezy brand is staging its Season 01 presentation on Wednesday night at Droam 1, its new Beverly Boulevard flagship in Los Angeles. It is the brand's first major runway show in more than four years.

fashion.headline: Rachel Scott and Ralph Lauren win Designer of the Year at the 2026 CFDA Awards
fashion.summary: Rachel Scott took womenswear designer of the year, and Ralph Lauren also won a Designer of the Year award at the CFDA Fashion Awards held at the American Museum of Natural History in New York.

marketing.headline: Ami Paris casts Catherine Deneuve as boutique manager in holiday campaign
marketing.summary: Ami Paris's Ami d'Hiver holiday campaign stars Catherine Deneuve in short scenes directed by Loïc Prigent. They are set in the brand's Place des Victoires boutique in Paris. The campaign drops Wednesday, and WWD had it first as an exclusive.

marketing.headline: John Lewis enlists Kristin Scott Thomas and Sam Fender for 2026 Christmas campaign
marketing.summary: John Lewis has unveiled its 2026 festive campaign featuring Kristin Scott Thomas and musician Sam Fender, following teasers earlier in the week. It is the UK's most-watched Christmas ad slot.

marketing.headline: Publicis completes LiveRamp takeover and says Omnicom and WPP are still 'welcome' to use it
marketing.summary: Publicis has completed its $2.2bn LiveRamp acquisition, which the FTC cleared with conditions last month. The group is signalling that rival holding companies can keep using the data platform.

marketing.headline: Erling Haaland, Ilona Maher and Lewis Hamilton among winners of inaugural Meta x SportsPro Athlete Honours
marketing.summary: Meta and SportsPro launched an awards programme recognising athletes for creativity and craft in content creation across Meta's platforms. Haaland, Maher and Hamilton are among the first winners.

marketing.headline: Boots' CMO on getting shoppers talking this Christmas
marketing.summary: Boots CMO Charlotte Lock explains the retailer's move to position itself as the home of gifting. It is building on the early success of its 'Give It Some Boots' brand voice and innovating its media mix.
